purpose: Transparent organization-specific opportunity-screening and recommendation inputs.

positive_factors.name: service_alignment
positive_factors.description: Opportunity requirements match one or more active capabilities.

positive_factors.name: sector_alignment
positive_factors.description: Buyer or industry aligns with configured target sectors.

positive_factors.name: geographic_alignment
positive_factors.description: Place of performance aligns with configured geography or remote-delivery rules.

positive_factors.name: procurement_path_alignment
positive_factors.description: The procurement path is compatible with a configured participation mechanism.

positive_factors.name: staffing_family_alignment
positive_factors.description: Required roles map to configured staffing families.

positive_factors.name: evidence_completeness
positive_factors.description: Available opportunity information is sufficient to support an advisory recommendation.

default_exclusion_conditions: hardware installation only without consulting scope
services outside configured geography with no remote option
clearly disallowed certification or eligibility requirement
unknown_value_policy: Do not infer missing values; disclose the gap and hold or abstain when material.
notes: Weights are initial prototype defaults and must be validated through frozen scenarios. They do not represent award probability.
